episodes.title: Ned Dobsons Neice (1952-12-30)
episodes.episodeDescription: Greedy rancher Ned Dobson tries to keep his late brother's daughter Helen from claiming the half of the ranch left to her, using a forged deed and ordering his foreman to kidnap her until she signs away her inheritance, but Cisco uncovers the old fraud and frees Helen to establish her ownership.

episodes.title: The Cisco Kid Brings the Law (1953-01-01)

episodes.plotSynopsis: After cattle rustler Rance Thompson and gunmen Hank Allen and Snake Malone kill a succession of Cliff Mesa sheriffs, Cisco accepts appointment as acting sheriff and arrests them for Joe Johnson's murder, only to see a terrified jury acquit them; Cisco publicly humiliates the trio to break the town's fear, rearrests them for other crimes including an earlier sheriff's murder, and this time an emboldened jury convicts them of their long list of offenses.

episodes.plotSynopsis: After Mr. Morris discovers gold on land sold to him by Ed Patterson, Patterson steals the deed and lets suspicion fall on Pancho, but a talkative parrot that witnessed the theft gives Cisco the clue needed to expose the swindle.

episodes.episodeDescription: Tom Barton, known as the Baron of the Badlands, runs an isolated sanctuary where wanted criminals buy protection by surrendering their stolen money. When bank robber Jip Travers and his wife Nell hide part of their haul and try to use Cisco as protection from Barton, Cisco follows the deception back to the Badlands and helps bring the Baron, Travers, and Nell under the law.

episodes.episodeDescription: After a leg injury triggers a severe mental breakdown, an old friend becomes convinced Cisco and Pancho are his enemies, shoots at the law, and captures Pancho before Cisco rescues his amigo and prevents the disturbed man from being killed.

episodes.plotSynopsis: A financial panic sends frightened depositors rushing to empty a Cottonwood City bank, forcing Cisco and Pancho to help bring in an emergency shipment of gold while bandits and mistaken suspicion from the law threaten the delivery; they return the money in time to save the bank.

episodes.title: According to the Law (1953-01-29)
episodes.episodeDescription: A crooked rancher exploits a new law making cattle owners liable for crop damage by breaking a neighbor's fence, driving the neighbor's cattle into planted fields, and demanding payment, but Cisco uncovers the deliberate setup as the dispute turns violent and brings the responsible man to justice.
episodes.plotSynopsis: A crooked rancher exploits a new law making cattle owners liable for crop damage by breaking a neighbor's fence, driving the neighbor's cattle into planted fields, and demanding payment, but Cisco uncovers the deliberate setup as the dispute turns violent and brings the responsible man to justice.

episodes.plotSynopsis: Political boss Dutch Wheeler tries to seize the county seat for Ashley so he can dominate local government, threatening a newspaper editor and moving against the courthouse records, but Cisco secretly aids an old friend in law enforcement and helps expose Wheeler's coercion and crimes.

episodes.episodeDescription: Link McCann and Doc Moran tear up railroad track as a backup to their plan for robbing a gold special, murder the station agent, and try to cover their tracks, but Cisco reconstructs the scheme from the scene and their bootprints and turns both men over to the sheriff.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Link McCann and Doc Moran tear up railroad track as a backup to their plan for robbing a gold special, murder the station agent, and try to cover their tracks, but Cisco reconstructs the scheme from the scene and their bootprints and turns both men over to the sheriff.

episodes.title: The Wooing of Big Minnie (1953-02-17)
episodes.episodeDescription: Big Minnie Swenson publicly announces that she will marry the first suitable man who asks, attracting an unscrupulous stranger interested in her ranch, but Cisco and Pancho uncover his scheme, recover Minnie's property, and help clear the way for her to marry the man who genuinely cares for her.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Big Minnie Swenson publicly announces that she will marry the first suitable man who asks, attracting an unscrupulous stranger interested in her ranch, but Cisco and Pancho uncover his scheme, recover Minnie's property, and help clear the way for her to marry the man who genuinely cares for her.

episodes.title: Cashiered (1953-02-19)
episodes.episodeDescription: Former Army officer Major Allen returns to Windy Gulch still carrying the disgrace of being cashiered years earlier, but Cisco reopens the old case, exposes the rustlers whose deception caused Allen's downfall, and helps clear his name so he can receive posthumous military restoration and honors.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Former Army officer Major Allen returns to Windy Gulch still carrying the disgrace of being cashiered years earlier, but Cisco reopens the old case, exposes the rustlers whose deception caused Allen's downfall, and helps clear his name so he can receive posthumous military restoration and honors.

episodes.title: Bullets and Ballets (1953-02-24)
episodes.episodeDescription: Cattle rustler Fargo Monson hires gunman Red Alton to drive honest Frank Vincent out of the sheriff's race, but Cisco and Pancho turn the intimidation against them and publicly humiliate the crooks, helping Vincent win the election by a landslide.

episodes.title: Dishonor Among Thieves (1953-02-26)
episodes.episodeDescription: Two hardcases hunt the partner who ran off with their stolen loot while Cisco and Pancho ride into an ambush and become entangled in the thieves' pursuit.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Two hardcases hunt the partner who ran off with their stolen loot while Cisco and Pancho ride into an ambush and become entangled in the thieves' pursuit.

episodes.plotSynopsis: Outlaw Denver George uses his near-identical twin brother Ned to confuse witnesses and help frame the innocent man for his crimes, but Cisco ultimately exposes the real gunman by exploiting the brothers' completely different reactions to a challenge.

episodes.title: The Son of Whitey King (1953-03-12)

episodes.plotSynopsis: Cisco and Pancho quietly evaluate young Sheriff Billy King for a federal marshal while Billy pretends to fear the vicious Neale gang, a ruse meant to uncover evidence that the outlaws murdered his famous lawman father.

episodes.title: Night Stage (1953-03-17)
episodes.episodeDescription: Cisco and Pancho ride to Pine Canyon to help acting sheriff Ed Walters trap bandit Joe Dawson, discovering that Dawson has forced old Pa Walters to sign away his home and working to recover the proof before capturing the gang.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Cisco and Pancho ride to Pine Canyon to help acting sheriff Ed Walters trap bandit Joe Dawson, discovering that Dawson has forced old Pa Walters to sign away his home and working to recover the proof before capturing the gang.

episodes.title: Gunman for Hire (1953-03-19)
episodes.episodeDescription: Rancher Walt Phipps hires deadly gunman Race Mackenzie to eliminate the sheriff of Dry Creek, but Cisco steps into the plot, defeats the hired killer, and exposes the man who paid for the attack.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Rancher Walt Phipps hires deadly gunman Race Mackenzie to eliminate the sheriff of Dry Creek, but Cisco steps into the plot, defeats the hired killer, and exposes the man who paid for the attack.

episodes.title: Flowers for Polly (1953-03-24)
episodes.episodeDescription: Cisco and Pancho postpone their pursuit of bandit Mike Marcus to cheer their ailing friend Aunt Parley with flowers, but Marcus's men ambush them, destroy the geranium, and help get them jailed; the pair escape, defeat the gang before it can finish its attack, and finally deliver fresh flowers that restore Parley's spirits.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Cisco and Pancho postpone their pursuit of bandit Mike Marcus to cheer their ailing friend Aunt Parley with flowers, but Marcus's men ambush them, destroy the geranium, and help get them jailed; the pair escape, defeat the gang before it can finish its attack, and finally deliver fresh flowers that restore Parley's spirits.

episodes.title: Bank Robbery in Cactus Junction (1953-03-26)

episodes.plotSynopsis: Bank clerk Alice Barton discovers that her suitor Bob Hastings has only been courting her to learn the bank's routines for a robbery with his partner Snake, and when the sheriff is away she turns to Cisco and Pancho, who stop the holdup and protect Alice from the returning gunmen.

episodes.title: Dynamite in Big Tressle (1953-03-31)
episodes.episodeDescription: Two fugitives responsible for an earlier dynamited train wreck discover a valuable underground ice deposit beneath a young woman's field and scheme to seize it, but Cisco uncovers the plot and stops a burning dynamite fuse before another train can be destroyed.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Two fugitives responsible for an earlier dynamited train wreck discover a valuable underground ice deposit beneath a young woman's field and scheme to seize it, but Cisco uncovers the plot and stops a burning dynamite fuse before another train can be destroyed.

episodes.title: Apologetic Killer (1953-04-02)

episodes.plotSynopsis: Cisco and Pancho are framed for the murder of rancher Big Dan Thomas by Curly Brace, a cold-blooded killer who apologizes before he strikes, and must escape custody, track Curly to the Thomas ranch, and prove who committed the crime.

episodes.title: Secret Mission (1953-04-07)

episodes.plotSynopsis: A territorial marshal secretly orders Cisco to pose as an outlaw and rob a bank so he can infiltrate the Malloy gang, forcing Cisco to deceive even Pancho until a planned train-robbery trap and the marshal's diary finally clear his name.

episodes.plotSynopsis: Banker Milo Jenkins secretly sets fires for the thrill of watching them burn and to buy ruined property cheaply, using an accomplice and murder to protect the scheme until Cisco lays a trap and catches him trying to ignite another house.

episodes.plotSynopsis: Joe and his partners sabotage a mountain logging flume with a heavy iron brake that throws valuable logs into the gorge so they can steal from old man Moller's operation, shooting at anyone who gets too close, but Cisco and Pancho expose the sabotage, capture the gang, and remove the brake so the logs can run normally again.

episodes.plotSynopsis: A Chicago archaeologist and his daughter travel to the Mojave Desert to examine a supposedly Egyptian mummy planted by con men, but when jewels are discovered in the mummy case the swindlers try to seize the treasure and Cisco and Pancho become caught in the scheme.

episodes.plotSynopsis: A gang plots to kidnap a railroad executive for ransom aboard the supposedly unlucky Old 13, and when his daughter mistakes Cisco and Pancho for the outlaws, the rescue becomes even more dangerous as Pancho winds up at the controls of the runaway train.

episodes.title: The Dude (1953-05-12)
episodes.episodeDescription: Cisco and Pancho defend a soft-spoken newcomer who finally strikes gold, then face a theft frame-up and a lynch-minded mining camp while the greedy claim jumpers move to seize his land.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Cisco and Pancho defend a soft-spoken newcomer who finally strikes gold, then face a theft frame-up and a lynch-minded mining camp while the greedy claim jumpers move to seize his land.

episodes.title: Night Before the Fair (1953-05-14)
episodes.episodeDescription: Rancher Will Strong hires Jarvis and Parks to sabotage the county fair and assault manager Lou Appleton, but after the thugs knock Cisco and Pancho unconscious and cut loose the fair balloon, Cisco uses the balloon's gas and ballast to survive, returns to the grounds, saves Appleton from being dragged by a rope, and forces the saboteurs to help make the fair a success.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Rancher Will Strong hires Jarvis and Parks to sabotage the county fair and assault manager Lou Appleton, but after the thugs knock Cisco and Pancho unconscious and cut loose the fair balloon, Cisco uses the balloon's gas and ballast to survive, returns to the grounds, saves Appleton from being dragged by a rope, and forces the saboteurs to help make the fair a success.

episodes.title: The Cattlemans War (1953-05-26)
episodes.episodeDescription: A feud between rival cattlemen escalates as both sides hire gunmen, drawing Cisco and Pancho into the conflict and forcing Cisco to act as sheriff while trying to prevent the dispute from turning into open war.
episodes.plotSynopsis: A feud between rival cattlemen escalates as both sides hire gunmen, drawing Cisco and Pancho into the conflict and forcing Cisco to act as sheriff while trying to prevent the dispute from turning into open war.

episodes.title: Contraband (1953-05-28)
episodes.episodeDescription: Smugglers Jack Horner, Moses Mill, and storekeeper John Riddland use muzzled burros to move contraband across the border and murder old Cottonwood Brown when he interferes, framing Cisco and Pancho; Cisco follows the burro tracks, proves the smuggling route to the sheriff, captures Horner and Mill, and tricks one criminal into exposing the murder.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Smugglers Jack Horner, Moses Mill, and storekeeper John Riddland use muzzled burros to move contraband across the border and murder old Cottonwood Brown when he interferes, framing Cisco and Pancho; Cisco follows the burro tracks, proves the smuggling route to the sheriff, captures Horner and Mill, and tricks one criminal into exposing the murder.

episodes.title: The Rustlers (1953-06-02)
episodes.episodeDescription: Cattleman Jake Sandoval orders the murder of young Indian Mato and tries to blame local tribes for a rustling operation, but Cisco and Pancho uncover the frame-up, bring the skeptical sheriff to witness the thefts, and capture Sandoval's gang.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Cattleman Jake Sandoval orders the murder of young Indian Mato and tries to blame local tribes for a rustling operation, but Cisco and Pancho uncover the frame-up, bring the skeptical sheriff to witness the thefts, and capture Sandoval's gang.

episodes.title: The Golden Slugs of Rainbow Falls (1953-06-04)
episodes.displayTitle: The Golden Slugs of Rainbow Falls (1953-06-04)
episodes.episodeDescription: Cisco and Pancho arrive at a mining camp already simmering with trouble, where robbery and murder force Cisco to follow the clues behind the violence.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Cisco and Pancho arrive at a mining camp already simmering with trouble, where robbery and murder force Cisco to follow the clues behind the violence.

episodes.title: The Trail of the Blood Red Sun (1953-06-09)
episodes.displayTitle: The Trail of the Blood Red Sun (1953-06-09)
episodes.sortKey: 0|1953-06-09|99999|the trail of the blood red sun (1953-06-09)
episodes.episodeDescription: As a vast locust swarm threatens a frontier community, bitter farmer Frank blames Dr. Anderson for his troubles and becomes violently delusional, shooting the doctor and setting fire to the house; Cisco and Pancho subdue him, and an extraordinary flock of seagulls arrives to devour the locusts, saving the crops and helping restore Frank's perspective.
episodes.plotSynopsis: As a vast locust swarm threatens a frontier community, bitter farmer Frank blames Dr. Anderson for his troubles and becomes violently delusional, shooting the doctor and setting fire to the house; Cisco and Pancho subdue him, and an extraordinary flock of seagulls arrives to devour the locusts, saving the crops and helping restore Frank's perspective.

episodes.title: The Duel (1953-06-11)
episodes.episodeDescription: With George Wayne facing execution for a bank-guard murder he did not commit, Cisco traces the real criminals to a storekeeper called the Duke, deliberately accepts the Duke's rapier challenge before young Joe Austin can fight him, defeats him in the duel, forces the truth about the robbery and killing into the open, and gets word to the governor in time for Wayne to be reprieved.
episodes.plotSynopsis: With George Wayne facing execution for a bank-guard murder he did not commit, Cisco traces the real criminals to a storekeeper called the Duke, deliberately accepts the Duke's rapier challenge before young Joe Austin can fight him, defeats him in the duel, forces the truth about the robbery and killing into the open, and gets word to the governor in time for Wayne to be reprieved.

episodes.title: The Saga of Morbid Jones (1953-06-16)
episodes.episodeDescription: A new law will cost Morbid Jones his mineral-rich mountain claim unless it is reopened and worked by midnight, so Dan Ryan and an accomplice wait through a blizzard to seize it and shoot anyone who interferes; Cisco and Pancho survive the ambush, rescue Morbid from the plot, and get him back to the claim in time to preserve his ownership.
episodes.plotSynopsis: A new law will cost Morbid Jones his mineral-rich mountain claim unless it is reopened and worked by midnight, so Dan Ryan and an accomplice wait through a blizzard to seize it and shoot anyone who interferes; Cisco and Pancho survive the ambush, rescue Morbid from the plot, and get him back to the claim in time to preserve his ownership.

episodes.title: Blazing Guns at Lone Bend (1953-06-18)
episodes.episodeDescription: Hotheaded cattleman Bud Cushman tries to turn the Long Bend dispute between cattlemen and nesters into open war, murdering nester Bob Black and pushing both sides toward bloodshed; after Cisco and Pancho are captured and nearly hanged, Cisco defeats Cushman and the dead man's diamond ring found in Cushman's pocket exposes him as the killer, allowing the two factions to agree to settle their differences peacefully.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Hotheaded cattleman Bud Cushman tries to turn the Long Bend dispute between cattlemen and nesters into open war, murdering nester Bob Black and pushing both sides toward bloodshed; after Cisco and Pancho are captured and nearly hanged, Cisco defeats Cushman and the dead man's diamond ring found in Cushman's pocket exposes him as the killer, allowing the two factions to agree to settle their differences peacefully.

episodes.episodeDescription: Released outlaw Gus Benz returns to Lucifer to murder the jurors who convicted him, leaving 3-7-77 grave-dimension tags on his victims and targeting crippled Larry Lincoln as well as Cisco, but Cisco escapes Benz's trap, runs him down on Diablo, prevents a lynching, and turns him over to the law.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Released outlaw Gus Benz returns to Lucifer to murder the jurors who convicted him, leaving 3-7-77 grave-dimension tags on his victims and targeting crippled Larry Lincoln as well as Cisco, but Cisco escapes Benz's trap, runs him down on Diablo, prevents a lynching, and turns him over to the law.

episodes.title: Devil Town (1953-06-25)
episodes.episodeDescription: Outlaw boss Sawyer Benson terrorizes the aptly named Devil Town and tries to force Prudence Kerry off her ranch, but Cisco and Pancho break his hold on the settlement, force Benson to confess, and help the marshal arrest his gang so Prudence can keep her property in peace.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Outlaw boss Sawyer Benson terrorizes the aptly named Devil Town and tries to force Prudence Kerry off her ranch, but Cisco and Pancho break his hold on the settlement, force Benson to confess, and help the marshal arrest his gang so Prudence can keep her property in peace.

episodes.title: Dynamite in the Blue Chip Mine (1953-06-30)
episodes.displayTitle: Dynamite in the Blue Chip Mine (1953-06-30)
episodes.episodeDescription: Crooked gambler Braley alters Grayson's IOUs, cheats him out of the Blue Chip Mine, and kills him when the fraud is challenged, but Cisco proves the notes were changed, links the deception to Braley, and wins a confession that restores the mine to Grayson's daughter.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Crooked gambler Braley alters Grayson's IOUs, cheats him out of the Blue Chip Mine, and kills him when the fraud is challenged, but Cisco proves the notes were changed, links the deception to Braley, and wins a confession that restores the mine to Grayson's daughter.

episodes.title: Hoodoo Driver (1953-07-02)
episodes.episodeDescription: Rancher Blake Lee ambushes a mountain stage in an attempt to kill Cisco and stage driver Bo Whip, then leaves Cisco under suspicion for Whip's murder, but Cisco traces the gun evidence to Lee and his accomplice, captures them, and clears his own name.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Rancher Blake Lee ambushes a mountain stage in an attempt to kill Cisco and stage driver Bo Whip, then leaves Cisco under suspicion for Whip's murder, but Cisco traces the gun evidence to Lee and his accomplice, captures them, and clears his own name.

episodes.title: Prophet of Boot Hill (1953-07-07)
episodes.episodeDescription: Two bank robbers hide their stolen gold beneath the floor of the eccentric old 'prophet' who lives near Boot Hill, then return and kill him when they fear he can expose them, leaving Cisco and Pancho briefly under suspicion until Cisco recovers the loot and the criminals betray one another and reveal the truth.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Two bank robbers hide their stolen gold beneath the floor of the eccentric old 'prophet' who lives near Boot Hill, then return and kill him when they fear he can expose them, leaving Cisco and Pancho briefly under suspicion until Cisco recovers the loot and the criminals betray one another and reveal the truth.

episodes.title: The Golden Bullet (1953-07-09)
episodes.episodeDescription: Recently released outlaw Rex hunts the lost gold of a massacred forty-niner wagon train after learning his foster father, Colonel Benson, has found it, murdering Benson and later turning on his own accomplice, but Cisco survives Rex's attempts to eliminate him, recovers the treasure, and sends Rex back to justice.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Recently released outlaw Rex hunts the lost gold of a massacred forty-niner wagon train after learning his foster father, Colonel Benson, has found it, murdering Benson and later turning on his own accomplice, but Cisco survives Rex's attempts to eliminate him, recovers the treasure, and sends Rex back to justice.

episodes.title: Gun War at Oak Pass (1953-07-14)
episodes.episodeDescription: Escaped killer Chuck Madrone has driven the Daggett family from its ranch and terrorized the town around Oak Pass, then returns with his gang to kill Joe Daggett and Cisco; Cisco and Pancho organize a handful of riders, trap the outlaws at the pass, capture Madrone for the law, and restore the Daggetts to their home.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Escaped killer Chuck Madrone has driven the Daggett family from its ranch and terrorized the town around Oak Pass, then returns with his gang to kill Joe Daggett and Cisco; Cisco and Pancho organize a handful of riders, trap the outlaws at the pass, capture Madrone for the law, and restore the Daggetts to their home.

episodes.title: The Seven Devils (1953-07-16)
episodes.episodeDescription: Lawyer Brad Kellman and ranch foreman Rick Corson plan to kill Stella's elderly relative during a cowboy masquerade, using identical devil costumes and a staged fire to conceal their movements so they can profit from his will, but Cisco breaks through the costume alibis and exposes the pair before the inheritance plot can succeed.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Lawyer Brad Kellman and ranch foreman Rick Corson plan to kill Stella's elderly relative during a cowboy masquerade, using identical devil costumes and a staged fire to conceal their movements so they can profit from his will, but Cisco breaks through the costume alibis and exposes the pair before the inheritance plot can succeed.

episodes.title: The 5000 Reward (1953-07-21)
episodes.episodeDescription: Former stage guard John Tully, crippled during a robbery five years earlier in which his driver was killed and $5,000 stolen, gets a chance to ride the same route again after Cisco identifies the old robbers by a distinctive white scar and secretly arranges a trap that lets Tully face them and recover justice.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Former stage guard John Tully, crippled during a robbery five years earlier in which his driver was killed and $5,000 stolen, gets a chance to ride the same route again after Cisco identifies the old robbers by a distinctive white scar and secretly arranges a trap that lets Tully face them and recover justice.

episodes.title: The Hondo Boys (1953-07-23)
episodes.episodeDescription: The feared Hondo brothers, Ben and Smoky, terrorize Mesa after two of their men are jailed, burning the jail and threatening anyone who resists them, but Cisco and Pancho protect young Jerry and his grandfather, survive the gang's attacks, and help state troopers round up the Hondo outfit without allowing vigilante revenge.
episodes.plotSynopsis: The feared Hondo brothers, Ben and Smoky, terrorize Mesa after two of their men are jailed, burning the jail and threatening anyone who resists them, but Cisco and Pancho protect young Jerry and his grandfather, survive the gang's attacks, and help state troopers round up the Hondo outfit without allowing vigilante revenge.

episodes.title: The Mad Woman of Desolation House (1953-08-18)
episodes.displayTitle: The Mad Woman of Desolation House (1953-08-18)
episodes.episodeDescription: After an eccentric old woman takes a young girl, Cisco joins the sheriff's search and begins to suspect that the apparent kidnapper may not be the true danger.
episodes.plotSynopsis: After an eccentric old woman takes a young girl, Cisco joins the sheriff's search and begins to suspect that the apparent kidnapper may not be the true danger.

episodes.title: The Key of Death (1953-08-20)
episodes.episodeDescription: Rancher Kayler schemes to wreck a cattle train so debtor Donlin cannot make his payment and Kayler can seize the ranch, murdering a telegraph operator for the switch key, but Cisco and Pancho uncover the sabotage, prove the killing with a torn neckerchief, and force Kayler to confess and grant Donlin an extension.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Rancher Kayler schemes to wreck a cattle train so debtor Donlin cannot make his payment and Kayler can seize the ranch, murdering a telegraph operator for the switch key, but Cisco and Pancho uncover the sabotage, prove the killing with a torn neckerchief, and force Kayler to confess and grant Donlin an extension.

episodes.title: Renegade (1953-09-01)
episodes.episodeDescription: Army deserter Todd Hollison leads a band of Mescalero Apaches in a campaign of revenge against Major Reynolds and his friends, marking each attack with a taunting arrow, but Cisco and Pancho help the fort break the renegade's hold over the raiders and capture Hollison.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Army deserter Todd Hollison leads a band of Mescalero Apaches in a campaign of revenge against Major Reynolds and his friends, marking each attack with a taunting arrow, but Cisco and Pancho help the fort break the renegade's hold over the raiders and capture Hollison.

episodes.title: The Railroad War (1953-09-03)
episodes.episodeDescription: Powerful landowner Burke Meadows tries to stop a railroad from crossing his territory by seizing adjoining land and using hired gunmen against the construction crew, but Cisco and Pancho turn the tables on Meadows and end the short, violent railroad war.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Powerful landowner Burke Meadows tries to stop a railroad from crossing his territory by seizing adjoining land and using hired gunmen against the construction crew, but Cisco and Pancho turn the tables on Meadows and end the short, violent railroad war.

episodes.title: Black Jack Larue (1953-09-10)
episodes.episodeDescription: Black Jack LaRue's scheming lieutenant deliberately pits the outlaw chief against Cisco, kills a deputy and helps imprison Cisco and Pancho, then tries to manipulate and betray his own gang, but Cisco escapes, survives a dynamite threat, and breaks up the outfit.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Black Jack LaRue's scheming lieutenant deliberately pits the outlaw chief against Cisco, kills a deputy and helps imprison Cisco and Pancho, then tries to manipulate and betray his own gang, but Cisco escapes, survives a dynamite threat, and breaks up the outfit.

episodes.title: Gunplay on the Riverfront (1953-09-17)
episodes.episodeDescription: Cold-eyed gunman Count Steerland tries to seize a settler's valuable riverfront claim by force, attacking the father and putting his young son in deadly danger on the river, but Cisco and Pancho rescue the family, defeat Steerland's gang, and help the wounded settler rebuild.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Cold-eyed gunman Count Steerland tries to seize a settler's valuable riverfront claim by force, attacking the father and putting his young son in deadly danger on the river, but Cisco and Pancho rescue the family, defeat Steerland's gang, and help the wounded settler rebuild.

episodes.title: The Red-headed Cowpoke (1953-09-29)
episodes.episodeDescription: Cattle rustler Big Ed Boland tries to remove young cowpoke Red Mallory by making him jealous of Cisco over Daisy, hoping one man will kill the other; when that fails Boland moves directly against Red, but Cisco exposes the frame-up and the rustling plot.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Cattle rustler Big Ed Boland tries to remove young cowpoke Red Mallory by making him jealous of Cisco over Daisy, hoping one man will kill the other; when that fails Boland moves directly against Red, but Cisco exposes the frame-up and the rustling plot.

episodes.title: His Honor the Killer (1953-10-01)
episodes.episodeDescription: Mayor George Harley secretly murders each new town marshal as revenge for the lawman who once sent him to prison, but Cisco recognizes the mayor's prison-bred habits, escapes captivity, and exposes Harley as the killer behind Black Rock's string of deaths.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Mayor George Harley secretly murders each new town marshal as revenge for the lawman who once sent him to prison, but Cisco recognizes the mayor's prison-bred habits, escapes captivity, and exposes Harley as the killer behind Black Rock's string of deaths.

episodes.title: Law of the Forty-four (1953-10-06)
episodes.episodeDescription: Two bullying gunmen terrorize the countryside and target Cisco, Pancho, and their friends during a community dance, leaving Cisco to survive gunfire and a burning cabin before turning the tables on them.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Two bullying gunmen terrorize the countryside and target Cisco, Pancho, and their friends during a community dance, leaving Cisco to survive gunfire and a burning cabin before turning the tables on them.

episodes.title: Planted Gold (1953-10-08)
episodes.episodeDescription: Two crooks plant gold-bearing rocks on worthless land and imprison honest broker Sam Morland so they can swindle a visiting couple into buying the property, but Cisco and Pancho uncover the planted evidence and stop the sale.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Two crooks plant gold-bearing rocks on worthless land and imprison honest broker Sam Morland so they can swindle a visiting couple into buying the property, but Cisco and Pancho uncover the planted evidence and stop the sale.

episodes.title: The Red Demon (1953-10-13)
episodes.episodeDescription: A pair of crooked brick salesmen secretly set fires to create new business, and Cisco must clear his own name, unite rival fire companies, and expose the arsonists before more homes burn.
episodes.plotSynopsis: A pair of crooked brick salesmen secretly set fires to create new business, and Cisco must clear his own name, unite rival fire companies, and expose the arsonists before more homes burn.

episodes.title: Masquerade (1953-10-15)
episodes.episodeDescription: Two cowhands disguise themselves as Cisco and Pancho to rob a stagecoach and bury the stolen money with their costumes, leaving the real pair blamed for the crime until Cisco finds the hidden clothes and forces the impostors' scheme into the open.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Two cowhands disguise themselves as Cisco and Pancho to rob a stagecoach and bury the stolen money with their costumes, leaving the real pair blamed for the crime until Cisco finds the hidden clothes and forces the impostors' scheme into the open.

episodes.title: Frontier Justice (1953-10-27)
episodes.episodeDescription: Bank president Sim Condon murders his cashier to conceal a large shortage caused by gambling debts and frames an innocent man for the crime, but Cisco uses the bank books and ballistic evidence to expose the embezzlement and force Condon to confess.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Bank president Sim Condon murders his cashier to conceal a large shortage caused by gambling debts and frames an innocent man for the crime, but Cisco uses the bank books and ballistic evidence to expose the embezzlement and force Condon to confess.

episodes.title: The Battle of the Border (1953-10-29)
episodes.episodeDescription: Outlaw Global Cain uses a border-river technicality to operate from a criminal stronghold beyond the reach of American law and even steals Cisco's horse, but Cisco joins the border rangers against the gang and a change in the river channel finally leaves Cain standing on United States soil where he can be arrested.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Outlaw Global Cain uses a border-river technicality to operate from a criminal stronghold beyond the reach of American law and even steals Cisco's horse, but Cisco joins the border rangers against the gang and a change in the river channel finally leaves Cain standing on United States soil where he can be arrested.

episodes.title: The Double (1953-11-03)
episodes.episodeDescription: A crooked lawyer and his partners recruit a man who closely resembles Cisco to impersonate him, take control of a dying rancher's property held in trust for daughter Madge, and kill the real Cisco, but the imposture collapses when Cisco survives and exposes the double.
episodes.plotSynopsis: A crooked lawyer and his partners recruit a man who closely resembles Cisco to impersonate him, take control of a dying rancher's property held in trust for daughter Madge, and kill the real Cisco, but the imposture collapses when Cisco survives and exposes the double.

episodes.title: To Uphold the Law (1953-11-05)
episodes.episodeDescription: After the Conway brothers are sprung from custody in a deadly ambush, Cisco and Pancho help the wounded law track the gang and expose Mosch Arnold, a seemingly respectable drifter who hides a career of robbery and murder behind outlaw allies.
episodes.plotSynopsis: After the Conway brothers are sprung from custody in a deadly ambush, Cisco and Pancho help the wounded law track the gang and expose Mosch Arnold, a seemingly respectable drifter who hides a career of robbery and murder behind outlaw allies.

episodes.title: The Blacksmith (1953-11-12)
episodes.episodeDescription: Outlaws Earl and Curly prey on gullible blacksmith Jeddy Beecher, flattering him into helping their schemes and trying to make him the fall guy for a bank robbery, but Cisco recognizes the manipulation and stops the brothers before Jeddy crosses the line into serious crime.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Outlaws Earl and Curly prey on gullible blacksmith Jeddy Beecher, flattering him into helping their schemes and trying to make him the fall guy for a bank robbery, but Cisco recognizes the manipulation and stops the brothers before Jeddy crosses the line into serious crime.

episodes.title: Posse of Killers (1953-11-24)
episodes.episodeDescription: During a silver boom in Rockledge, cafe owner Rip Mears hires gunmen and coerces a claims agent into backdating a claim over the town's main street so he can seize valuable property, but Cisco breaks up his posse of killers and exposes the fraudulent land grab.
episodes.plotSynopsis: During a silver boom in Rockledge, cafe owner Rip Mears hires gunmen and coerces a claims agent into backdating a claim over the town's main street so he can seize valuable property, but Cisco breaks up his posse of killers and exposes the fraudulent land grab.

episodes.title: Murder at Ten Below (1953-11-26)
episodes.episodeDescription: Two killers stretch a wire across a snowy mountain mail route to murder a ski courier carrying valuable diamonds, but Cisco and Pancho brave the brutal Ten Below country, uncover the trap, and bring the robbers down before they can escape with the loot.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Two killers stretch a wire across a snowy mountain mail route to murder a ski courier carrying valuable diamonds, but Cisco and Pancho brave the brutal Ten Below country, uncover the trap, and bring the robbers down before they can escape with the loot.

episodes.title: Pattern of Crime (1953-12-08)
episodes.episodeDescription: A group of outlaws gathers around a plan to steal a cache of diamonds just as Cisco and Pancho ride toward Cottonwood and into the developing robbery scheme.
episodes.plotSynopsis: A group of outlaws gathers around a plan to steal a cache of diamonds just as Cisco and Pancho ride toward Cottonwood and into the developing robbery scheme.

episodes.title: The Killer Stallion (1953-12-10)
episodes.episodeDescription: A wealthy smuggler covets a prized stallion and resorts to intimidation, theft and murder to get the horse, but Cisco and Pancho stand with the ranch family, track the criminals toward the border, and break up the gang before the stallion can be taken.
episodes.plotSynopsis: A wealthy smuggler covets a prized stallion and resorts to intimidation, theft and murder to get the horse, but Cisco and Pancho stand with the ranch family, track the criminals toward the border, and break up the gang before the stallion can be taken.

episodes.title: The Cayote Pup (1953-12-15)
episodes.episodeDescription: Big Jake Griggs murders a settler to steal his lush, well-watered ranch and sends a henchman after the owner's young son, but the boy escapes into the brush; Cisco and Pancho protect the child, expose Griggs' land grab, and restore the ranch to safety.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Big Jake Griggs murders a settler to steal his lush, well-watered ranch and sends a henchman after the owner's young son, but the boy escapes into the brush; Cisco and Pancho protect the child, expose Griggs' land grab, and restore the ranch to safety.

episodes.title: The Boxcar Bandits (1953-12-17)
episodes.episodeDescription: Bank robbers Max Benson and Matt Swain use freight boxcars as mobile hideouts, timing their daylight robberies around train stops so they can escape unseen, but Cisco recognizes the pattern, tracks them back to the railroad, and ends their run of robberies.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Bank robbers Max Benson and Matt Swain use freight boxcars as mobile hideouts, timing their daylight robberies around train stops so they can escape unseen, but Cisco recognizes the pattern, tracks them back to the railroad, and ends their run of robberies.

episodes.title: Valley of Killers (1953-12-22)
episodes.episodeDescription: The Cullen gang rules a hidden canyon known as the Valley of Killers and rides into River Bend to murder two men who shot one of their outlaws in self-defense, but Cisco and Pancho help the frightened town resist, break the gang's power, and make the valley safe.
episodes.plotSynopsis: The Cullen gang rules a hidden canyon known as the Valley of Killers and rides into River Bend to murder two men who shot one of their outlaws in self-defense, but Cisco and Pancho help the frightened town resist, break the gang's power, and make the valley safe.

episodes.title: Dude Bandit (1953-12-24)
episodes.episodeDescription: Respectable-looking rancher Heck Dover is secretly the Dude Bandit, using fancy clothes and strong perfume to create a misleading outlaw identity while he and Waldo Dane rob stages and commit murder, but Cisco follows the perfume clue to Dover's home, recovers the stolen money, and turns both men over to the sheriff.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Respectable-looking rancher Heck Dover is secretly the Dude Bandit, using fancy clothes and strong perfume to create a misleading outlaw identity while he and Waldo Dane rob stages and commit murder, but Cisco follows the perfume clue to Dover's home, recovers the stolen money, and turns both men over to the sheriff.

episodes.title: Guns in the Rain (1953-12-29)
episodes.episodeDescription: Seeking shelter from a driving rain, Cisco and Pancho unknowingly enter the hideout of Pose Wyman's outlaw gang and are trapped upstairs while the killers try to burn them out with black-powder bombs, but they escape through the weakened roof, defeat the gang, and help a young recruit face his punishment and choose a better life afterward.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Seeking shelter from a driving rain, Cisco and Pancho unknowingly enter the hideout of Pose Wyman's outlaw gang and are trapped upstairs while the killers try to burn them out with black-powder bombs, but they escape through the weakened roof, defeat the gang, and help a young recruit face his punishment and choose a better life afterward.

episodes.title: The Great Land Rush (1953-12-31)
episodes.episodeDescription: Land speculator Jim Ruford hires Sanders and Ridge to murder Olson and eliminate his nephew Tom Crisp so Ruford can file a false claim on Olson's strategically valuable property during the Sagebrush Valley land rush, while arranging for Cisco to take the blame; Cisco escapes the frame-up, protects Tom, exposes the hired killers and Ruford's scheme, and stops the fraudulent claim before it can succeed.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Land speculator Jim Ruford hires Sanders and Ridge to murder Olson and eliminate his nephew Tom Crisp so Ruford can file a false claim on Olson's strategically valuable property during the Sagebrush Valley land rush, while arranging for Cisco to take the blame; Cisco escapes the frame-up, protects Tom, exposes the hired killers and Ruford's scheme, and stops the fraudulent claim before it can succeed.

episodes.title: Sniffer Smith (1954-01-12)
episodes.episodeDescription: Jeb 'Sniffer' Smith and Bar Morris rob a stage carrying gold, kill the guard, and later eliminate a wounded witness, but Cisco notices evidence that one robber was injured and traces the clue back to Smith's constant visits for medicine; after the outlaws attack Cisco and the sheriff, Pancho exploits Smith's hypochondria with a well-timed sneeze and panic forces the truth out before both men are jailed.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Jeb 'Sniffer' Smith and Bar Morris rob a stage carrying gold, kill the guard, and later eliminate a wounded witness, but Cisco notices evidence that one robber was injured and traces the clue back to Smith's constant visits for medicine; after the outlaws attack Cisco and the sheriff, Pancho exploits Smith's hypochondria with a well-timed sneeze and panic forces the truth out before both men are jailed.

episodes.title: Riders in the Night (1954-01-14)
episodes.episodeDescription: Crooked rancher Mace Spangler tries to seize John Middleton's ranch after the county records burn by sending men to steal Middleton's canceled mortgage and payment receipts, leaving him without proof that the debt was paid; Cisco and Pancho uncover the theft, recover the canceled note, defeat Spangler and his riders, and return the evidence that secures Middleton's ranch.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Crooked rancher Mace Spangler tries to seize John Middleton's ranch after the county records burn by sending men to steal Middleton's canceled mortgage and payment receipts, leaving him without proof that the debt was paid; Cisco and Pancho uncover the theft, recover the canceled note, defeat Spangler and his riders, and return the evidence that secures Middleton's ranch.

episodes.title: Avalanche and Morbid Jones (1954-01-19)
episodes.episodeDescription: Carter and Norton follow lucky prospector Morbid Jones into the mountains and use dynamite to trigger avalanches intended to bury Morbid and his wife so they can take over his gold claim in the spring; Cisco and Pancho become trapped in the snowbound cabin with the Joneses, survive the gunfire and repeated slides, and defeat the plot before the claim can be stolen.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Carter and Norton follow lucky prospector Morbid Jones into the mountains and use dynamite to trigger avalanches intended to bury Morbid and his wife so they can take over his gold claim in the spring; Cisco and Pancho become trapped in the snowbound cabin with the Joneses, survive the gunfire and repeated slides, and defeat the plot before the claim can be stolen.

episodes.title: Son of the Chief (1954-01-21)
episodes.episodeDescription: Former cavalryman Magoon Fraley seeks revenge on retired Colonel Duncan by rustling his cattle and planting evidence to blame Sioux chief Swift Antelope, while hiding the fact that years earlier he kidnapped Duncan's young son and left the boy to be raised among the Sioux; Cisco exposes Fraley's scheme, captures him, reveals that Swift Antelope's adopted son Billy is Duncan's missing child, and helps end the old feud without forcing the boy to abandon the chief who raised him.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Former cavalryman Magoon Fraley seeks revenge on retired Colonel Duncan by rustling his cattle and planting evidence to blame Sioux chief Swift Antelope, while hiding the fact that years earlier he kidnapped Duncan's young son and left the boy to be raised among the Sioux; Cisco exposes Fraley's scheme, captures him, reveals that Swift Antelope's adopted son Billy is Duncan's missing child, and helps end the old feud without forcing the boy to abandon the chief who raised him.

episodes.title: Claim Jumpers (1954-01-26)
episodes.episodeDescription: Dishonest assayer Ed Jessop falsely tells prospector Sam Fowler that his rich claim is worthless, then has honest assayer Reid Colby killed when Colby refuses to support the fraud and frames Cisco, Pancho, and Fowler for the murder; Cisco finds Colby's body, uses the forged note, gun-butt evidence, and Fowler's stolen ore samples to expose Jessop and his partner and preserve Fowler's valuable strike.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Dishonest assayer Ed Jessop falsely tells prospector Sam Fowler that his rich claim is worthless, then has honest assayer Reid Colby killed when Colby refuses to support the fraud and frames Cisco, Pancho, and Fowler for the murder; Cisco finds Colby's body, uses the forged note, gun-butt evidence, and Fowler's stolen ore samples to expose Jessop and his partner and preserve Fowler's valuable strike.

episodes.title: Beyond the Frontier (1954-01-28)
episodes.episodeDescription: Notorious outlaw Monty Talon massacres travelers crossing the remote Saucer country and captures Cisco, Pancho, and a marshal, even offering Cisco a place in his gang before threatening to kill them when Cisco refuses; Cisco escapes the trap, helps free the prisoners, captures Talon, and leads the law against the leaderless gang so the frontier route can be used safely again.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Notorious outlaw Monty Talon massacres travelers crossing the remote Saucer country and captures Cisco, Pancho, and a marshal, even offering Cisco a place in his gang before threatening to kill them when Cisco refuses; Cisco escapes the trap, helps free the prisoners, captures Talon, and leads the law against the leaderless gang so the frontier route can be used safely again.

episodes.title: Phantom Bandits (1954-02-02)
episodes.episodeDescription: Bank robbers Leo Planey and Mel Pollard stay ahead of the law because Dolly, secretly Planey's wife, works near the sheriff's office and warns them whenever a posse is coming; when Pancho becomes acting sheriff and closes in, Dolly helps the outlaws ambush Cisco, but Cisco and Pancho survive the betrayal, capture Planey and Pollard, and uncover Dolly's role in the phantom bandit operation.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Bank robbers Leo Planey and Mel Pollard stay ahead of the law because Dolly, secretly Planey's wife, works near the sheriff's office and warns them whenever a posse is coming; when Pancho becomes acting sheriff and closes in, Dolly helps the outlaws ambush Cisco, but Cisco and Pancho survive the betrayal, capture Planey and Pollard, and uncover Dolly's role in the phantom bandit operation.

episodes.title: Cisco Takes the Trail (1954-02-04)
episodes.episodeDescription: Two of Mark McDonald's former prospecting partners kidnap him in hopes of forcing him to reveal a valuable mine map and later capture Pancho and Mark's young son when they interfere, but Cisco follows the trail to the hideout, frees the captives, and sends the kidnappers to jail.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Two of Mark McDonald's former prospecting partners kidnap him in hopes of forcing him to reveal a valuable mine map and later capture Pancho and Mark's young son when they interfere, but Cisco follows the trail to the hideout, frees the captives, and sends the kidnappers to jail.

episodes.title: When Six Guns Speak (1954-02-09)
episodes.episodeDescription: Wealthy merchant Norwell Kane hires gunman Dutch Freeman and his men to drive competing storekeepers Dave and Minnie Wayland out of Remrock, but Cisco and Pancho break the intimidation scheme, force the compromised sheriff out, and leave Dave as acting sheriff with Kane warned against further trouble.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Wealthy merchant Norwell Kane hires gunman Dutch Freeman and his men to drive competing storekeepers Dave and Minnie Wayland out of Remrock, but Cisco and Pancho break the intimidation scheme, force the compromised sheriff out, and leave Dave as acting sheriff with Kane warned against further trouble.

episodes.title: Golden Anvil (1954-02-11)
episodes.episodeDescription: Outlaws learn that an old rancher is carrying a gold shipment to his nephew and move to steal it, but after the rancher is murdered Cisco discovers the fortune was hidden in plain sight as a small black-painted anvil made of solid gold and helps the sheriff send the killers to jail.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Outlaws learn that an old rancher is carrying a gold shipment to his nephew and move to steal it, but after the rancher is murdered Cisco discovers the fortune was hidden in plain sight as a small black-painted anvil made of solid gold and helps the sheriff send the killers to jail.

episodes.title: Lady Sheriff of Sandy Gulch (1954-02-16)
episodes.episodeDescription: Badger Jones and Coolfoot Snyder ambush a stage expecting to steal a male sheriff's jail keys and free outlaw Jeff Dalton, only to discover that Sandy Gulch's sheriff is the formidable Patricia Perkins, and Cisco and Pancho help her survive the gang's traps, stop Dalton's escape, and return the outlaws to custody.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Badger Jones and Coolfoot Snyder ambush a stage expecting to steal a male sheriff's jail keys and free outlaw Jeff Dalton, only to discover that Sandy Gulch's sheriff is the formidable Patricia Perkins, and Cisco and Pancho help her survive the gang's traps, stop Dalton's escape, and return the outlaws to custody.

episodes.title: Jail Rush (1954-02-18)
episodes.episodeDescription: A protection gang forces county ranchers to pay tribute or lose their cattle, and after one rancher is murdered the leader is jailed just as an angry lynch mob arrives and the gang attacks to free him, but Cisco prevents both the lynching and the jailbreak, breaks the extortion ring, and leaves an honest rancher serving as acting sheriff.
episodes.plotSynopsis: A protection gang forces county ranchers to pay tribute or lose their cattle, and after one rancher is murdered the leader is jailed just as an angry lynch mob arrives and the gang attacks to free him, but Cisco prevents both the lynching and the jailbreak, breaks the extortion ring, and leaves an honest rancher serving as acting sheriff.

episodes.title: Cross Examination (1954-03-02)
episodes.episodeDescription: Sam Dublin kills John Smedley and frames John's brother Pete so that a relative can inherit the Smedley property and sell it to him, but Cisco interrupts Pete's trial, proves the fatal bullet came from Dublin's uncommon .44-40 rifle rather than Pete's revolver, and exposes the scheme in court.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Sam Dublin kills John Smedley and frames John's brother Pete so that a relative can inherit the Smedley property and sell it to him, but Cisco interrupts Pete's trial, proves the fatal bullet came from Dublin's uncommon .44-40 rifle rather than Pete's revolver, and exposes the scheme in court.

episodes.title: The Law at Rocky Creek (1954-03-04)
episodes.episodeDescription: Banker Jordan secretly runs an open cattle-rustling operation in Rocky Creek, using Joe Dodd and other gunmen to steal Fleming's herd and intimidate anyone who resists, but Cisco traces the cattle to Jordan's ranch, gathers the missing evidence, and stops Jordan as he tries to force Fleming to sign a false paid-in-full receipt.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Banker Jordan secretly runs an open cattle-rustling operation in Rocky Creek, using Joe Dodd and other gunmen to steal Fleming's herd and intimidate anyone who resists, but Cisco traces the cattle to Jordan's ranch, gathers the missing evidence, and stops Jordan as he tries to force Fleming to sign a false paid-in-full receipt.

episodes.title: Shoot to Kill (1954-03-23)
episodes.episodeDescription: Bitter cowboy Carlos Blake pressures young Ricky Hart into robbing and murdering storekeeper Tom Dustin, then the pair rob the town bank and take Pancho and Dustin's niece Sarah hostage to keep Cisco away; Cisco tracks them back to the store, breaks the siege, rescues the hostages, and stops Blake and Hart before they can escape.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Bitter cowboy Carlos Blake pressures young Ricky Hart into robbing and murdering storekeeper Tom Dustin, then the pair rob the town bank and take Pancho and Dustin's niece Sarah hostage to keep Cisco away; Cisco tracks them back to the store, breaks the siege, rescues the hostages, and stops Blake and Hart before they can escape.

episodes.title: Sheriff Phantom (1954-03-25)
episodes.episodeDescription: Cattle rustler Joe Naral tries to ruin Sheriff Bill Fanton's reelection by hiring fast gunman Mose to provoke and kill Fanton supporter Hook Hastings, hoping the unsolved crime will turn voters against the sheriff, but Cisco and Pancho expose the scheme, help break Naral's gang, and Fanton wins the election.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Cattle rustler Joe Naral tries to ruin Sheriff Bill Fanton's reelection by hiring fast gunman Mose to provoke and kill Fanton supporter Hook Hastings, hoping the unsolved crime will turn voters against the sheriff, but Cisco and Pancho expose the scheme, help break Naral's gang, and Fanton wins the election.

episodes.title: Avalanche in Arrow Pass (1954-03-30)
episodes.episodeDescription: Crooked railroad marshal Joe Metz and deputy Hal Shoff plan to dynamite an avalanche into Arrow Pass so a $50,000 payroll wagon must take an alternate route where they can rob it, but Cisco uncovers the diversion, recovers the payroll, and sends Metz and Shoff to jail.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Crooked railroad marshal Joe Metz and deputy Hal Shoff plan to dynamite an avalanche into Arrow Pass so a $50,000 payroll wagon must take an alternate route where they can rob it, but Cisco uncovers the diversion, recovers the payroll, and sends Metz and Shoff to jail.

episodes.title: The Return of the Laughing Bandit (1954-04-01)
episodes.displayTitle: The Return of the Laughing Bandit (1954-04-01)
episodes.episodeDescription: The escaped Laughing Bandit returns to Great Oak country seeking revenge on Cisco, kidnaps the sheriff's son and ties him beside a rising underground lake as bait, but Cisco and Pancho reach the cave in time, rescue the prisoner, and help capture the bandit and his henchman for good.
episodes.plotSynopsis: The escaped Laughing Bandit returns to Great Oak country seeking revenge on Cisco, kidnaps the sheriff's son and ties him beside a rising underground lake as bait, but Cisco and Pancho reach the cave in time, rescue the prisoner, and help capture the bandit and his henchman for good.

episodes.title: Killers at Large (1954-04-06)
episodes.episodeDescription: Two wanted killers terrorize a Pineville ranch family and flee toward lawless Sage City, where cattle rustler Blaine Billings gives them shelter, but Cisco tracks them to Billings' ranch and fights through the rustlers to bring the fugitives back to face the law.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Two wanted killers terrorize a Pineville ranch family and flee toward lawless Sage City, where cattle rustler Blaine Billings gives them shelter, but Cisco tracks them to Billings' ranch and fights through the rustlers to bring the fugitives back to face the law.

episodes.title: Waters of the Flood (1954-04-08)
episodes.episodeDescription: After murdering a storekeeper over ammunition, Park Sanders and Jenks Doolins hunt witness George Willard and dynamite a dam to flood his home and destroy evidence, but Cisco and Pancho survive the flood, follow the killers, rescue Willard, and deliver the pair to the sheriff.
episodes.plotSynopsis: After murdering a storekeeper over ammunition, Park Sanders and Jenks Doolins hunt witness George Willard and dynamite a dam to flood his home and destroy evidence, but Cisco and Pancho survive the flood, follow the killers, rescue Willard, and deliver the pair to the sheriff.

episodes.title: The Braggart (1954-04-13)
episodes.episodeDescription: Two bank robbers exploit local braggart Hunt Hurley by goading him into a showdown with Cisco, then shoot Hunt from hiding so Cisco will be blamed for murder while they rob the bank, but Cisco and Pancho escape the frame-up, capture the real gunmen, and clear Cisco's name.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Two bank robbers exploit local braggart Hunt Hurley by goading him into a showdown with Cisco, then shoot Hunt from hiding so Cisco will be blamed for murder while they rob the bank, but Cisco and Pancho escape the frame-up, capture the real gunmen, and clear Cisco's name.

episodes.title: To Stop a Killer (1954-04-15)
episodes.episodeDescription: Patient killer Bud Marlon returns after years to settle an old score with rancher Ed Carson, surrounding himself with gunmen and drawing the local law into the feud, but Cisco survives Marlon's attacks, rounds up the gang, and finally delivers the wanted killer to jail.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Patient killer Bud Marlon returns after years to settle an old score with rancher Ed Carson, surrounding himself with gunmen and drawing the local law into the feud, but Cisco survives Marlon's attacks, rounds up the gang, and finally delivers the wanted killer to jail.

episodes.title: Showdown at Quicksand Bend (1954-04-22)
episodes.episodeDescription: Cattle rustlers learn Cisco is coming to investigate and deliberately direct him and Pancho toward the deadly crossing at Quicksand Bend, but the trap fails; Cisco follows the evidence back to the gang, recovers the stolen cattle, and sends the rustlers to jail.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Cattle rustlers learn Cisco is coming to investigate and deliberately direct him and Pancho toward the deadly crossing at Quicksand Bend, but the trap fails; Cisco follows the evidence back to the gang, recovers the stolen cattle, and sends the rustlers to jail.

episodes.title: The Tactless Sheriff (1954-08-03)
episodes.episodeDescription: Cattleman Jack Alton engineers a wave of rustling, including thefts from his own herd, to discredit unpopular Sheriff Bill McCann before the election, then kidnaps McCann's daughter to force his resignation until Cisco and Pancho break the scheme and rescue her.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Cattleman Jack Alton engineers a wave of rustling, including thefts from his own herd, to discredit unpopular Sheriff Bill McCann before the election, then kidnaps McCann's daughter to force his resignation until Cisco and Pancho break the scheme and rescue her.

episodes.title: Convict Valley (1954-08-05)
episodes.episodeDescription: The outlaw settlement of Convict Valley retaliates when newspaper editor Tom Morse urges nearby citizens to wipe out the criminal haven, but Cisco and Pancho rally the law-abiding town, rescue Morse, and help return the valley's fugitives to jail.
episodes.plotSynopsis: The outlaw settlement of Convict Valley retaliates when newspaper editor Tom Morse urges nearby citizens to wipe out the criminal haven, but Cisco and Pancho rally the law-abiding town, rescue Morse, and help return the valley's fugitives to jail.

episodes.title: The British Come Home to Brimstone (1954-08-10)
episodes.displayTitle: The British Come Home to Brimstone (1954-08-10)
episodes.episodeDescription: Ranch manager Rex Parker has been stealing cattle from Pamela Havisham's inherited spread and hiding them on an isolated mesa reached through a waterfall, then plots to kill Pamela before she arrives, but Cisco foils the ambush, discovers the hidden herd, and ends Parker's scheme.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Ranch manager Rex Parker has been stealing cattle from Pamela Havisham's inherited spread and hiding them on an isolated mesa reached through a waterfall, then plots to kill Pamela before she arrives, but Cisco foils the ambush, discovers the hidden herd, and ends Parker's scheme.

episodes.title: Outlaw Trail (1954-08-12)
episodes.episodeDescription: Two killers flee into the Gunstock Hills after robbing a store and murdering its owner, then kill a prospector and try to stay ahead of the sheriff, but Cisco and Pancho help track them down and their own knowledge of the earlier crime betrays them.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Two killers flee into the Gunstock Hills after robbing a store and murdering its owner, then kill a prospector and try to stay ahead of the sheriff, but Cisco and Pancho help track them down and their own knowledge of the earlier crime betrays them.

episodes.title: Tin Horn Killer (1954-08-17)
episodes.episodeDescription: Stage robbers manipulate a hotheaded young gunman into challenging Cisco while arranging for Cisco's revolvers to be loaded with blanks, hoping to remove the gold shipment's escort, but Cisco survives the setup, stops the robbery, and the wounded youth learns the cost of chasing a gunfighter's reputation.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Stage robbers manipulate a hotheaded young gunman into challenging Cisco while arranging for Cisco's revolvers to be loaded with blanks, hoping to remove the gold shipment's escort, but Cisco survives the setup, stops the robbery, and the wounded youth learns the cost of chasing a gunfighter's reputation.

episodes.title: Vengeance at Wind Rock (1954-08-19)
episodes.episodeDescription: Larry Carson returns to Windrock from prison blaming his marshal father Frank for sending him away, and criminals exploit that bitterness in a revenge scheme, but Cisco uncovers the manipulation, Larry learns the truth, and father and son reconcile after the conspirators are jailed.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Larry Carson returns to Windrock from prison blaming his marshal father Frank for sending him away, and criminals exploit that bitterness in a revenge scheme, but Cisco uncovers the manipulation, Larry learns the truth, and father and son reconcile after the conspirators are jailed.

episodes.title: Trial by Tomahawk (1954-09-07)
episodes.episodeDescription: Land speculator Jack Cogland tries to provoke a war with the Nez Perce by having his gunmen raid them in stolen U.S. cavalry uniforms and steal their horses, but Cisco survives a tomahawk trial, proves the soldiers were impostors, and wins Chief Joseph's help in exposing the false-flag scheme before it can ignite wider bloodshed.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Land speculator Jack Cogland tries to provoke a war with the Nez Perce by having his gunmen raid them in stolen U.S. cavalry uniforms and steal their horses, but Cisco survives a tomahawk trial, proves the soldiers were impostors, and wins Chief Joseph's help in exposing the false-flag scheme before it can ignite wider bloodshed.

episodes.title: The Ace of Hearts (1954-09-09)
episodes.episodeDescription: A gunman bent on revenge against retiring Sheriff John Dixon sends ominous playing cards to Dixon and his family before moving against them one by one, but Cisco intervenes, defeats the attacker, and helps protect the sheriff's family as Dixon returns to duty.
episodes.plotSynopsis: A gunman bent on revenge against retiring Sheriff John Dixon sends ominous playing cards to Dixon and his family before moving against them one by one, but Cisco intervenes, defeats the attacker, and helps protect the sheriff's family as Dixon returns to duty.

episodes.title: Murder at the Triple S (1954-09-14)
episodes.episodeDescription: Ruthless outlaw Roof Dunbar targets the Triple S ranch as a new base, murders the ranch hands, and plans to force owner Hannah Wesley and her visiting father to sign the spread over to him, but Cisco and Pancho rescue the family and turn Dunbar and his lieutenant over to the law.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Ruthless outlaw Roof Dunbar targets the Triple S ranch as a new base, murders the ranch hands, and plans to force owner Hannah Wesley and her visiting father to sign the spread over to him, but Cisco and Pancho rescue the family and turn Dunbar and his lieutenant over to the law.

episodes.title: Who Lives by the Six Gun (1954-09-16)
episodes.displayTitle: Who Lives by the Six Gun (1954-09-16)
episodes.episodeDescription: Cold-blooded killer Snake Rollins robs a store, murders its owner for sport, and hunts the surviving witness, drawing Cisco into the chase; Rollins' violent path finally turns back on him when his own outlaw associate guns him down during the final confrontation.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Cold-blooded killer Snake Rollins robs a store, murders its owner for sport, and hunts the surviving witness, drawing Cisco into the chase; Rollins' violent path finally turns back on him when his own outlaw associate guns him down during the final confrontation.

episodes.title: Rustlers on the Lazy D (1954-09-28)
episodes.episodeDescription: Two trusted Lazy D cowhands secretly rustle their employer's cattle and decide Cisco must die when they learn he has been called in to investigate, but Cisco survives their attack, uncovers the inside job, and helps recover the stolen herd and expose the disloyal foreman and gunman.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Two trusted Lazy D cowhands secretly rustle their employer's cattle and decide Cisco must die when they learn he has been called in to investigate, but Cisco survives their attack, uncovers the inside job, and helps recover the stolen herd and expose the disloyal foreman and gunman.

episodes.title: War on the Fort (1954-09-30)
episodes.episodeDescription: Former soldier Ned and his partner learn that Fort Harlow is concealing a payroll shipment beneath hay and organize a nighttime attack on the post, but Cisco and Pancho help Major Harlow defend the fort, recover the payroll, and capture the raiders after the brief battle.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Former soldier Ned and his partner learn that Fort Harlow is concealing a payroll shipment beneath hay and organize a nighttime attack on the post, but Cisco and Pancho help Major Harlow defend the fort, recover the payroll, and capture the raiders after the brief battle.

episodes.title: Black Kerchief (1954-10-05)
episodes.episodeDescription: Stage driver Big Mac Tulsa secretly signals his road-agent partners with a black kerchief whenever valuable cargo is aboard, helping them rob repeated gold shipments while pretending to fight back, but Cisco uncovers the signal, turns the next holdup against the gang, and helps recover the stolen gold.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Stage driver Big Mac Tulsa secretly signals his road-agent partners with a black kerchief whenever valuable cargo is aboard, helping them rob repeated gold shipments while pretending to fight back, but Cisco uncovers the signal, turns the next holdup against the gang, and helps recover the stolen gold.

episodes.title: Terror Town (1954-10-07)
episodes.episodeDescription: Sandy Creek marshal Drew Kegel uses his badge and deadly gun skill to extort protection money from townspeople, killing anyone who resists under the pretense of self-defense, but Cisco breaks Kegel's reign of terror, forces him to repay his victims, and sends him to prison.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Sandy Creek marshal Drew Kegel uses his badge and deadly gun skill to extort protection money from townspeople, killing anyone who resists under the pretense of self-defense, but Cisco breaks Kegel's reign of terror, forces him to repay his victims, and sends him to prison.

episodes.title: The River of No Return (1954-12-28)
episodes.episodeDescription: Bill Fenwick follows the mysterious River of No Return to the hidden mine left by his father, only to be captured by the men who murdered the elder Fenwick and seized the mine. Cisco, Pancho, and Bill's wife Maggie enter the cavern, survive a dynamite trap, discover the river's hidden route, rescue Bill, and capture the killers.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Bill Fenwick follows the mysterious River of No Return to the hidden mine left by his father, only to be captured by the men who murdered the elder Fenwick and seized the mine. Cisco, Pancho, and Bill's wife Maggie enter the cavern, survive a dynamite trap, discover the river's hidden route, rescue Bill, and capture the killers.

episodes.title: The Capture of Billy Vaca (1954-12-30)
episodes.episodeDescription: Notorious bank robber Billy Vaca and his gang raid a bank and kill the cashier, then terrorize the town while the sheriff struggles to respond. Cisco and Pancho identify the gang, defend the jail from an attempted rescue, capture Vaca's men in a final fight, and help recover most of the stolen money.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Notorious bank robber Billy Vaca and his gang raid a bank and kill the cashier, then terrorize the town while the sheriff struggles to respond. Cisco and Pancho identify the gang, defend the jail from an attempted rescue, capture Vaca's men in a final fight, and help recover most of the stolen money.

episodes.title: The Brand of the Maverick (1955-01-04)
episodes.episodeDescription: Rustlers Nate Willes and Tim Bolin murder Hank Myers and try to steal the Myers brothers' valuable registered cattle brand by forcing county recorder Morgan Myers to transfer it into their name, while manipulating the sheriff into treating Cisco and Pancho as the outlaws; Cisco turns the mistake around, exposes the real rustlers, and preserves the Myers brand and cattle.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Rustlers Nate Willes and Tim Bolin murder Hank Myers and try to steal the Myers brothers' valuable registered cattle brand by forcing county recorder Morgan Myers to transfer it into their name, while manipulating the sheriff into treating Cisco and Pancho as the outlaws; Cisco turns the mistake around, exposes the real rustlers, and preserves the Myers brand and cattle.

episodes.title: Rodeo at Calico Corners (1955-01-11)
episodes.episodeDescription: Rodeo-following bank robbers Bryce Tabor and Cannon Roy plan to hit Calico Corners while Sheriff Gordon is distracted showing his prized horse Baby, then hide among the beard-growing contestants after the alarm is raised; Cisco and Pancho survive the pair's ambush at the bank, chase them through the rodeo grounds, capture them, and recover the bank while Baby still wins her prize.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Rodeo-following bank robbers Bryce Tabor and Cannon Roy plan to hit Calico Corners while Sheriff Gordon is distracted showing his prized horse Baby, then hide among the beard-growing contestants after the alarm is raised; Cisco and Pancho survive the pair's ambush at the bank, chase them through the rodeo grounds, capture them, and recover the bank while Baby still wins her prize.

episodes.title: Murder Wagon (1955-01-13)
episodes.episodeDescription: Freight haulers Jesse Post and Pierre Doolack murder isolated ranch families, burn their homes, and load the victims' furniture and valuables into a 'murder wagon' for resale; sent by the territorial marshal to investigate the string of deadly ranch fires, Cisco and Pancho survive the killers' ambush, turn the trap against them, and expose the robbery-murder scheme.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Freight haulers Jesse Post and Pierre Doolack murder isolated ranch families, burn their homes, and load the victims' furniture and valuables into a 'murder wagon' for resale; sent by the territorial marshal to investigate the string of deadly ranch fires, Cisco and Pancho survive the killers' ambush, turn the trap against them, and expose the robbery-murder scheme.

episodes.title: The Voice of the .44 (1955-01-18)
episodes.episodeDescription: Red Toomey and his gang ride into Mesquite planning to take over the town, and Cisco helps the elderly marshal arrest Toomey. The gang forces blacksmith Mike Werfel into helping with a jailbreak, but Cisco turns the scheme against them, jails the gang, then rides after Toomey when he threatens the marshal at his ranch and defeats the outlaw in a final showdown.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Red Toomey and his gang ride into Mesquite planning to take over the town, and Cisco helps the elderly marshal arrest Toomey. The gang forces blacksmith Mike Werfel into helping with a jailbreak, but Cisco turns the scheme against them, jails the gang, then rides after Toomey when he threatens the marshal at his ranch and defeats the outlaw in a final showdown.

episodes.title: Heritage of Death (1955-01-20)
episodes.episodeDescription: Arthur Dobson, guardian of young Bobby Hargis, will inherit the boy's large ranch if Bobby dies, so he hires foreman Kirby Lawson to arrange a fatal 'accident'; Lawson frightens the horses at a flooded bridge and sends Bobby into the raging river, but Cisco rescues the boy, defeats Lawson, and sends both conspirators to jail while Bobby remains on the ranch with the Robertsons.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Arthur Dobson, guardian of young Bobby Hargis, will inherit the boy's large ranch if Bobby dies, so he hires foreman Kirby Lawson to arrange a fatal 'accident'; Lawson frightens the horses at a flooded bridge and sends Bobby into the raging river, but Cisco rescues the boy, defeats Lawson, and sends both conspirators to jail while Bobby remains on the ranch with the Robertsons.

episodes.title: Gold at Bitter Creek (1955-01-25)
episodes.episodeDescription: Mel Clemens and Adler Ferris discover gold in Bitter Creek but cannot claim it because the land belongs to the townspeople, so they fake a richer strike elsewhere and lure nearly the whole town away; Cisco and Pancho arrive to find Bitter Creek deserted, survive the outlaws' gunfire, rescue the wounded sheriff, and force the pair to confess before the residents return to share in their own gold.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Mel Clemens and Adler Ferris discover gold in Bitter Creek but cannot claim it because the land belongs to the townspeople, so they fake a richer strike elsewhere and lure nearly the whole town away; Cisco and Pancho arrive to find Bitter Creek deserted, survive the outlaws' gunfire, rescue the wounded sheriff, and force the pair to confess before the residents return to share in their own gold.

episodes.title: The Cattle Train (1955-01-27)
episodes.episodeDescription: Cattle king Barney Rankin tries to destroy smaller rancher John Sawyer for competing for railroad space, first having Sawyer and Ed Beale beaten and then ordering gunman Mose Dillon to uncouple Sawyer's loaded cattle car on a grade; Cisco and Pancho race to stop the runaway car before it collides with an express train, then bring Rankin and his men to justice for assault and attempted murder.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Cattle king Barney Rankin tries to destroy smaller rancher John Sawyer for competing for railroad space, first having Sawyer and Ed Beale beaten and then ordering gunman Mose Dillon to uncouple Sawyer's loaded cattle car on a grade; Cisco and Pancho race to stop the runaway car before it collides with an express train, then bring Rankin and his men to justice for assault and attempted murder.

episodes.title: Murder at Pine Creek (1955-02-01)
episodes.episodeDescription: Broke outlaws Nolan Kane and Bert Morrow learn that Ira and Tom Nesbit keep their gold and savings outside the bank, murder Ira, and ransack his cabin while trying to establish an alibi that points suspicion toward Cisco and Pancho; Cisco anticipates that the killers will return for the hidden money, traps them at the cabin, and clears himself when the pair confess to the murder.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Broke outlaws Nolan Kane and Bert Morrow learn that Ira and Tom Nesbit keep their gold and savings outside the bank, murder Ira, and ransack his cabin while trying to establish an alibi that points suspicion toward Cisco and Pancho; Cisco anticipates that the killers will return for the hidden money, traps them at the cabin, and clears himself when the pair confess to the murder.

episodes.title: The Midget of Broken Spur (1955-02-03)
episodes.episodeDescription: A tiny outlaw called Little Sam mails himself aboard a train, robs the mail car of a large gold shipment, and leaves Cisco and Pancho under suspicion for the crime, but they uncover his scheme, capture Sam and his accomplices, and recover the stolen railroad money.
episodes.plotSynopsis: A tiny outlaw called Little Sam mails himself aboard a train, robs the mail car of a large gold shipment, and leaves Cisco and Pancho under suspicion for the crime, but they uncover his scheme, capture Sam and his accomplices, and recover the stolen railroad money.

episodes.title: Gun War in the Mountains (1955-02-10)
episodes.episodeDescription: Bank robber Mike Fora uses tracker Moss Wigan to mislead a sheriff's posse in the Black Mountains while his gang prepares an ambush, but Cisco and Pancho outmaneuver the outlaws, capture Fora and his chief men, catch Wigan trying to steal the loot for himself, and recover the bank's gold.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Bank robber Mike Fora uses tracker Moss Wigan to mislead a sheriff's posse in the Black Mountains while his gang prepares an ambush, but Cisco and Pancho outmaneuver the outlaws, capture Fora and his chief men, catch Wigan trying to steal the loot for himself, and recover the bank's gold.

episodes.title: The Manhunt (1955-03-03)
episodes.episodeDescription: Outlaw Scott Clemons escapes the Arizona territorial penitentiary determined to kill Cisco, setting off a hard pursuit complicated by a young boy who initially mistakes Cisco for the fugitive, but Cisco and Pancho stay on the trail until Clemons is stopped and the boy learns the truth.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Outlaw Scott Clemons escapes the Arizona territorial penitentiary determined to kill Cisco, setting off a hard pursuit complicated by a young boy who initially mistakes Cisco for the fugitive, but Cisco and Pancho stay on the trail until Clemons is stopped and the boy learns the truth.

episodes.title: Murder at Red Clay Bend (1955-03-10)
episodes.episodeDescription: Banker Blake Duncan secretly runs an outlaw gang and tries to frame his nephew Jim for a stage robbery and murder by planting Jim's glove at Red Clay Bend so Duncan can profit from the boy's removal, but Cisco spots the planted evidence, follows the red-clay clue to Duncan's henchman, and exposes the entire scheme.
