episodes.plotSynopsis: Banker Blake Duncan secretly runs an outlaw gang and tries to frame his nephew Jim for a stage robbery and murder by planting Jim's glove at Red Clay Bend so Duncan can profit from the boy's removal, but Cisco spots the planted evidence, follows the red-clay clue to Duncan's henchman, and exposes the entire scheme.

episodes.title: A Trap of Many Teeth (1955-03-15)
episodes.episodeDescription: Smooth bank robber Randolph Meeker poses as a harmless writer, arranges a stage robbery in which the driver and guard are killed, and frames Cisco and Pancho for the crime to keep the law occupied while his partners move against the Silver City bank, but Cisco recognizes the setup and turns Meeker's elaborate trap back on the gang.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Smooth bank robber Randolph Meeker poses as a harmless writer, arranges a stage robbery in which the driver and guard are killed, and frames Cisco and Pancho for the crime to keep the law occupied while his partners move against the Silver City bank, but Cisco recognizes the setup and turns Meeker's elaborate trap back on the gang.

episodes.title: Dynamite on the Right of Way (1955-03-17)
episodes.displayTitle: Dynamite on the Right of Way (1955-03-17)
episodes.episodeDescription: Land speculator Wally Moran buys up the railroad's planned route through Gopher Valley and then tries to sabotage the alternate right-of-way so the company will be forced to pay his inflated price, but Cisco and Pancho expose the scheme, protect the railroad men, and stop Moran's gang before the project can be wrecked.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Land speculator Wally Moran buys up the railroad's planned route through Gopher Valley and then tries to sabotage the alternate right-of-way so the company will be forced to pay his inflated price, but Cisco and Pancho expose the scheme, protect the railroad men, and stop Moran's gang before the project can be wrecked.

episodes.title: The Gun Slinger (1955-03-22)
episodes.episodeDescription: Jack Cole and Mel Droun murder a young man and cultivate suspicion that Cisco was responsible, sending deadly gunslinger Hub Ferris after him for revenge, but Cisco defeats Ferris without killing him and then exposes Cole and Droun as the real killers when their attempt to finish the frame-up collapses.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Jack Cole and Mel Droun murder a young man and cultivate suspicion that Cisco was responsible, sending deadly gunslinger Hub Ferris after him for revenge, but Cisco defeats Ferris without killing him and then exposes Cole and Droun as the real killers when their attempt to finish the frame-up collapses.

episodes.title: A Party for Sheriff Fanton (1955-03-25)
episodes.episodeDescription: Mad composer Gregory Macey can only find inspiration through violence and murder, so he captures Pancho and invites Cisco, Sheriff Fanton, and stage passenger Felicity Spring to his isolated mansion as intended victims for the climax of his concerto; Cisco uses Macey's vanity about his music to get close enough to strike, turns the gunmen against their leader, and helps the sheriff end the murder plot.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Mad composer Gregory Macey can only find inspiration through violence and murder, so he captures Pancho and invites Cisco, Sheriff Fanton, and stage passenger Felicity Spring to his isolated mansion as intended victims for the climax of his concerto; Cisco uses Macey's vanity about his music to get close enough to strike, turns the gunmen against their leader, and helps the sheriff end the murder plot.

episodes.title: A Medal for Markmanship (1955-04-26)
episodes.episodeDescription: Mine owner Carl Monroe plots to destroy the Fair Friday mine and eliminate his partner Chris Mitchell, using a silver marksmanship medal to identify the hired gunman who is to receive dynamite plans hidden in a box-supper sandwich, but Cisco uncovers the arrangement, breaks up the gang, and sends the gunman to jail.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Mine owner Carl Monroe plots to destroy the Fair Friday mine and eliminate his partner Chris Mitchell, using a silver marksmanship medal to identify the hired gunman who is to receive dynamite plans hidden in a box-supper sandwich, but Cisco uncovers the arrangement, breaks up the gang, and sends the gunman to jail.

episodes.title: The Hot Headed Sheepherder (1955-05-05)
episodes.episodeDescription: Hot-tempered sheepherder Blinker McKay is trying to control his anger so postmistress Mona will marry him when criminals discover gold connected to the ground where his sheep have been grazing and try to force the location from him, but Cisco and Pancho defeat the gang while Blinker struggles to keep his temper in check.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Hot-tempered sheepherder Blinker McKay is trying to control his anger so postmistress Mona will marry him when criminals discover gold connected to the ground where his sheep have been grazing and try to force the location from him, but Cisco and Pancho defeat the gang while Blinker struggles to keep his temper in check.

episodes.title: The Hour of Terror (1955-05-12)
episodes.episodeDescription: A Buckthorn mob prepares to lynch Joe Love before he can stand trial for a killing, even threatening the sheriff who protects him, but Cisco faces down the ringleaders, breaks the mob's momentum, and insists that Joe be judged by law; Joe is later tried and acquitted.
episodes.plotSynopsis: A Buckthorn mob prepares to lynch Joe Love before he can stand trial for a killing, even threatening the sheriff who protects him, but Cisco faces down the ringleaders, breaks the mob's momentum, and insists that Joe be judged by law; Joe is later tried and acquitted.

episodes.title: Dead Mans Gold (1955-08-18)
episodes.episodeDescription: Prospector Fred Gates discovers a rich strike and offers to share it with fugitive Harold Alpine, who shoots him and leaves him for dead; Cisco secretly saves Fred and uses the supposed death to trap Alpine and murderous blacksmith Jory Goodell, whose own past crimes are also exposed.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Prospector Fred Gates discovers a rich strike and offers to share it with fugitive Harold Alpine, who shoots him and leaves him for dead; Cisco secretly saves Fred and uses the supposed death to trap Alpine and murderous blacksmith Jory Goodell, whose own past crimes are also exposed.

episodes.title: Law of the Dead (1955-08-23)
episodes.episodeDescription: A gang massacres a band of Gypsy travelers and tries to escape blame as Cisco and Pancho investigate, but a survivor identifies the killers; when the Gypsies capture the ringleader and demand justice under their own law, Cisco wins the right to turn him over to the sheriff for lawful trial.
episodes.plotSynopsis: A gang massacres a band of Gypsy travelers and tries to escape blame as Cisco and Pancho investigate, but a survivor identifies the killers; when the Gypsies capture the ringleader and demand justice under their own law, Cisco wins the right to turn him over to the sheriff for lawful trial.

episodes.title: Double Cross Gila Bend (1955-08-30)
episodes.episodeDescription: A crooked scheme in Gila Bend begins when Paul Morgan stages himself as a hero by killing wanted Tex Rollins, then joins local conspirators trying to profit from land needed for a railroad right-of-way, but Cisco uncovers the double cross, survives their attempt to eliminate him, and breaks the conspiracy.
episodes.plotSynopsis: A crooked scheme in Gila Bend begins when Paul Morgan stages himself as a hero by killing wanted Tex Rollins, then joins local conspirators trying to profit from land needed for a railroad right-of-way, but Cisco uncovers the double cross, survives their attempt to eliminate him, and breaks the conspiracy.

episodes.title: Silk Hat Herbert (1955-09-01)
episodes.episodeDescription: Silk Hat Herbert Hicks hides his criminal past from his sister Katie, then binds her, attacks banker Caleb Lewis for the vault combination, and attempts to rob the bank, but Cisco and Pancho intervene and capture Herbert before he can kill anyone or escape with the money.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Silk Hat Herbert Hicks hides his criminal past from his sister Katie, then binds her, attacks banker Caleb Lewis for the vault combination, and attempts to rob the bank, but Cisco and Pancho intervene and capture Herbert before he can kill anyone or escape with the money.

episodes.title: Hermit of Tall Tree Mt (1955-09-06)
episodes.episodeDescription: Rustler Link Foggin repeatedly evades the sheriff by using a hermit high on Tall Tree Mountain as a lookout who signals when the law approaches, but Cisco recognizes the signal system, traces it to the mountain, and helps the posse capture Foggin and his cattle thieves.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Rustler Link Foggin repeatedly evades the sheriff by using a hermit high on Tall Tree Mountain as a lookout who signals when the law approaches, but Cisco recognizes the signal system, traces it to the mountain, and helps the posse capture Foggin and his cattle thieves.

episodes.title: Ventriloquist (1955-09-08)
episodes.episodeDescription: A traveling medicine-show ventriloquist and his small-statured partner use voice tricks, a wooden dummy, and murder to cover a string of express-office robberies, until Cisco recognizes the impersonation scheme and recovers the stolen money.
episodes.plotSynopsis: A traveling medicine-show ventriloquist and his small-statured partner use voice tricks, a wooden dummy, and murder to cover a string of express-office robberies, until Cisco recognizes the impersonation scheme and recovers the stolen money.

episodes.title: Lynch Mob (1955-09-13)
episodes.episodeDescription: Tim Ritter and his partner murder and rob a storekeeper, frame George Keel for the crime, bind the sheriff, and whip up a lynch mob, but Cisco and Pancho stop the hanging and help the sheriff capture the gang and clear Keel.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Tim Ritter and his partner murder and rob a storekeeper, frame George Keel for the crime, bind the sheriff, and whip up a lynch mob, but Cisco and Pancho stop the hanging and help the sheriff capture the gang and clear Keel.

episodes.title: Battle of Lost Mine (1955-09-15)
episodes.episodeDescription: Badger King and North Young seize a long-lost mine that rightfully belongs to the late owner's heirs, then try to stop Cisco from guiding the family back to it and force them to sign away their claim, but Cisco and Pancho defeat the pair and restore the mine to its rightful owners.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Badger King and North Young seize a long-lost mine that rightfully belongs to the late owner's heirs, then try to stop Cisco from guiding the family back to it and force them to sign away their claim, but Cisco and Pancho defeat the pair and restore the mine to its rightful owners.

episodes.title: Messenger of Doom (1955-09-22)
episodes.episodeDescription: Cora Gammel and her brother use carrier pigeons to pass stolen cattle-shipment information from a stockyard to a rustling gang, but Cisco and Pancho uncover the secret message system and help break the operation before another herd can disappear.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Cora Gammel and her brother use carrier pigeons to pass stolen cattle-shipment information from a stockyard to a rustling gang, but Cisco and Pancho uncover the secret message system and help break the operation before another herd can disappear.

episodes.title: Passport to Death (1955-10-04)
episodes.episodeDescription: Powerful Boyd Moser owns nearly every important business in Toyar and uses hired killers to silence anyone who challenges his rule, but Cisco helps the town resist, protects cafe owner Sully and the sheriff, and brings Moser's private reign to an end.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Powerful Boyd Moser owns nearly every important business in Toyar and uses hired killers to silence anyone who challenges his rule, but Cisco helps the town resist, protects cafe owner Sully and the sheriff, and brings Moser's private reign to an end.

episodes.title: Deputy Marshall (1955-10-06)
episodes.episodeDescription: Popular Roy Seagland hides a ruthless outlaw career behind small favors and a friendly reputation while he and Matty Ellness rob a gold stage, but Cisco and Pancho are sworn in as deputy marshals, expose Seagland, and connect his partner to an earlier murder.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Popular Roy Seagland hides a ruthless outlaw career behind small favors and a friendly reputation while he and Matty Ellness rob a gold stage, but Cisco and Pancho are sworn in as deputy marshals, expose Seagland, and connect his partner to an earlier murder.

episodes.title: Counterfeit Money (1955-10-13)
episodes.episodeDescription: Counterfeiters Bell Patton and Jumbo Mulligan use a newspaper office and printing press to manufacture convincing fake currency while plotting to kill a Treasury agent, but Cisco turns his outlaw reputation to advantage, uncovers the plates and bogus money, and delivers both men to the government.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Counterfeiters Bell Patton and Jumbo Mulligan use a newspaper office and printing press to manufacture convincing fake currency while plotting to kill a Treasury agent, but Cisco turns his outlaw reputation to advantage, uncovers the plates and bogus money, and delivers both men to the government.

episodes.title: Storm on the Lake (1955-10-18)
episodes.episodeDescription: Two thieves overpower a lakeboat captain and steal his vessel so they can hijack a valuable silver shipment from the mines, but Cisco and Pancho pursue them across the water, survive a dangerous storm, recover the boat and silver, and free the captured crew.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Two thieves overpower a lakeboat captain and steal his vessel so they can hijack a valuable silver shipment from the mines, but Cisco and Pancho pursue them across the water, survive a dangerous storm, recover the boat and silver, and free the captured crew.

episodes.title: Senor Bull Frog (1957-01-24)
episodes.episodeDescription: At Angel's Camp, Pancho's pet bullfrog accidentally exposes gold dust being skimmed from miners at a cafe, drawing Cisco and Pancho into a murder case; framed and jailed, they survive an attempt to drown them by diverting water into the jail, then use physical evidence from Albany Flat to expose the killers and stop another murder.
episodes.plotSynopsis: At Angel's Camp, Pancho's pet bullfrog accidentally exposes gold dust being skimmed from miners at a cafe, drawing Cisco and Pancho into a murder case; framed and jailed, they survive an attempt to drown them by diverting water into the jail, then use physical evidence from Albany Flat to expose the killers and stop another murder.

episodes.title: Marshall of Gold Fields (1957-02-05)
episodes.episodeDescription: Cisco arrives in lawless Goldfield as the territorial marshal charged with cleaning up the town, while a huge drifter named Arleigh becomes entangled in the crackdown because his mother believes he is the marshal; after Arleigh proves he is not a killer, Cisco shows mercy and sends him home to make good on her faith in him.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Cisco arrives in lawless Goldfield as the territorial marshal charged with cleaning up the town, while a huge drifter named Arleigh becomes entangled in the crackdown because his mother believes he is the marshal; after Arleigh proves he is not a killer, Cisco shows mercy and sends him home to make good on her faith in him.

episodes.title: Horse Race at Fort Sumner (1957-02-07)
episodes.episodeDescription: Two strangers arrive at Fort Sumner posing as respectable bankers and sponsor a dance and horse race to win the town's confidence, but their real plan ends in robbery and flight; Cisco and Pancho pursue the gang, recover Sam's stolen money, and bring the impostors in.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Two strangers arrive at Fort Sumner posing as respectable bankers and sponsor a dance and horse race to win the town's confidence, but their real plan ends in robbery and flight; Cisco and Pancho pursue the gang, recover Sam's stolen money, and bring the impostors in.

episodes.title: Ring of Fire (1957-02-12)
episodes.episodeDescription: Men hired by a creditor try to destroy Paul Croft's historic Oregon cattle drive by setting a ring of fire around his herd, hoping his failure will forfeit the ranch securing his loan, but Cisco defeats the sabotage, recovers stolen payoff money, and proves Croft satisfied the debt.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Men hired by a creditor try to destroy Paul Croft's historic Oregon cattle drive by setting a ring of fire around his herd, hoping his failure will forfeit the ranch securing his loan, but Cisco defeats the sabotage, recovers stolen payoff money, and proves Croft satisfied the debt.

episodes.title: The Flagstaff Diamonds (1957-02-14)
episodes.episodeDescription: Outlaws Mike Mulligan and Buckeye Pierce ambush a trusted courier carrying one hundred thousand dollars in diamonds to a Flagstaff ranch, but Cisco and Pancho pursue the thieves, recover the jewel case, and deliver the attackers to the law while the wounded courier recovers.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Outlaws Mike Mulligan and Buckeye Pierce ambush a trusted courier carrying one hundred thousand dollars in diamonds to a Flagstaff ranch, but Cisco and Pancho pursue the thieves, recover the jewel case, and deliver the attackers to the law while the wounded courier recovers.

episodes.title: Poker Chip Draw (1957-02-19)
episodes.episodeDescription: Gambler and gunman Matt Rebstock kills a poker opponent after being challenged over suspected cheating and then joins another badman in resisting the town's new marshal, but Cisco exposes the crooked draw, defeats the pair, and helps the marshal bring them in for murder and other crimes.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Gambler and gunman Matt Rebstock kills a poker opponent after being challenged over suspected cheating and then joins another badman in resisting the town's new marshal, but Cisco exposes the crooked draw, defeats the pair, and helps the marshal bring them in for murder and other crimes.

episodes.title: Morbid Jones and the Water Rights (1957-02-21)
episodes.displayTitle: Morbid Jones and the Water Rights (1957-02-21)
episodes.episodeDescription: A rancher secretly diverts Finale Creek before it reaches Morbid Jones' land, intending to monopolize the scarce water and drive Jones out during a drought, but Cisco and Pancho uncover the illegal channel, stop the gunmen enforcing it, and force the culprit to pay for the damage and restoration of the Jones property.
episodes.plotSynopsis: A rancher secretly diverts Finale Creek before it reaches Morbid Jones' land, intending to monopolize the scarce water and drive Jones out during a drought, but Cisco and Pancho uncover the illegal channel, stop the gunmen enforcing it, and force the culprit to pay for the damage and restoration of the Jones property.

episodes.title: Swindle at Steamboat Springs (1957-02-26)
episodes.episodeDescription: Two confidence men arrive in booming Steamboat Springs with a cheap stage-prop helmet they claim was worn by Hernando Cortes, planning to manipulate a merchant into buying it through a fake outside bidder. Cisco recognizes the swindle, uses the Spanish paper hidden in the helmet to reverse their trick, and sends the pair out of the territory poorer than they arrived.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Two confidence men arrive in booming Steamboat Springs with a cheap stage-prop helmet they claim was worn by Hernando Cortes, planning to manipulate a merchant into buying it through a fake outside bidder. Cisco recognizes the swindle, uses the Spanish paper hidden in the helmet to reverse their trick, and sends the pair out of the territory poorer than they arrived.

episodes.title: The Fresno Fire (1957-03-05)
episodes.episodeDescription: Bank robbers exploit a bitter rivalry between Fresno's sheriff and honorary fire chief by setting the jail ablaze while Cisco and Pancho are locked inside, counting on the town's fire crew to be distracted as they rob the bank; Cisco and Pancho escape through the flames, stop the robbery, and force the feuding officials to cooperate so Fresno is better protected from both fires and criminals.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Bank robbers exploit a bitter rivalry between Fresno's sheriff and honorary fire chief by setting the jail ablaze while Cisco and Pancho are locked inside, counting on the town's fire crew to be distracted as they rob the bank; Cisco and Pancho escape through the flames, stop the robbery, and force the feuding officials to cooperate so Fresno is better protected from both fires and criminals.

episodes.title: The Finnias Boys (1957-03-07)
episodes.episodeDescription: Caleb Finneas breaks his brother Tony out of the Rollins jail so the pair can join their gang in robbing a railroad express car, while Cisco is deputized by the Medicine Bow marshal to bring Tony back; Cisco and Pancho are captured at the gang's camp but escape, reach the train before the dynamite robbery succeeds, and return Tony to the marshal while Caleb goes back to jail in Rollins.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Caleb Finneas breaks his brother Tony out of the Rollins jail so the pair can join their gang in robbing a railroad express car, while Cisco is deputized by the Medicine Bow marshal to bring Tony back; Cisco and Pancho are captured at the gang's camp but escape, reach the train before the dynamite robbery succeeds, and return Tony to the marshal while Caleb goes back to jail in Rollins.

episodes.title: Battle of Wagon Box Corral (1957-03-12)
episodes.episodeDescription: A corrupt Indian agent and his accomplice deliberately inflame tensions between the Army and Red Cloud's Sioux, hoping a massacre will trigger a wider war; Cisco exposes the provocation, gets new repeating rifles and ammunition to the threatened soldiers, and has them demonstrate overwhelming firepower without killing a single warrior, prompting Red Cloud to call off the charge and allowing the conspirators to be brought to trial.
episodes.plotSynopsis: A corrupt Indian agent and his accomplice deliberately inflame tensions between the Army and Red Cloud's Sioux, hoping a massacre will trigger a wider war; Cisco exposes the provocation, gets new repeating rifles and ammunition to the threatened soldiers, and has them demonstrate overwhelming firepower without killing a single warrior, prompting Red Cloud to call off the charge and allowing the conspirators to be brought to trial.

episodes.title: Opera in Albuquerque (1957-03-14)
episodes.episodeDescription: Outlaw Arch Collins, bitter that soprano Della Morelli rejected him and married impresario Giuseppe Duran, ambushes their touring opera company and tries to force the couple to sign over their financial interests before drowning them; Cisco follows the gang, escapes Collins's trap and regains the upper hand, while Pancho helps round up the remaining gunmen, allowing the company and scenery to reach Albuquerque in time for Aida, with Pancho joining the triumphal march.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Outlaw Arch Collins, bitter that soprano Della Morelli rejected him and married impresario Giuseppe Duran, ambushes their touring opera company and tries to force the couple to sign over their financial interests before drowning them; Cisco follows the gang, escapes Collins's trap and regains the upper hand, while Pancho helps round up the remaining gunmen, allowing the company and scenery to reach Albuquerque in time for Aida, with Pancho joining the triumphal march.

episodes.title: Judge Colts Law (1957-03-19)
episodes.episodeDescription: Fugitives Harley Griswold and his partner return to the Monroe ranch seeking money hidden there by the late outlaw Dutch Monroe, while Dutch's son Kip wrongly believes Cisco murdered his father; Kip's mother reveals the truth about Dutch's criminal life, the fugitives admit their connection to his death and threaten the family for the stolen money, and Cisco uses a dynamite bluff to capture them before Kip turns the hidden loot over to the law.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Fugitives Harley Griswold and his partner return to the Monroe ranch seeking money hidden there by the late outlaw Dutch Monroe, while Dutch's son Kip wrongly believes Cisco murdered his father; Kip's mother reveals the truth about Dutch's criminal life, the fugitives admit their connection to his death and threaten the family for the stolen money, and Cisco uses a dynamite bluff to capture them before Kip turns the hidden loot over to the law.

episodes.title: Emerald of the Aztecs (1957-03-21)
episodes.episodeDescription: Cisco is asked to investigate the theft of Walker's priceless Aztec emerald and traces the jewel to a known dealer in stolen goods, where the hotheaded young thief opens fire and Cisco and Pancho are imprisoned; the criminals then move against Walker to silence him, but Cisco escapes their trap, stops the gang, and brings the stolen emerald case to a close.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Cisco is asked to investigate the theft of Walker's priceless Aztec emerald and traces the jewel to a known dealer in stolen goods, where the hotheaded young thief opens fire and Cisco and Pancho are imprisoned; the criminals then move against Walker to silence him, but Cisco escapes their trap, stops the gang, and brings the stolen emerald case to a close.

episodes.title: Wild Horse Hunt (1957-03-26)
episodes.episodeDescription: Two ruthless gold seekers believe the legendary great white Mustang can lead them to the Lost Dutchman Mine and join a wild-horse hunt with Cisco, Pancho, and another prospector, but their greed turns murderous when they try to eliminate the others; Cisco survives their attacks, prevents them from destroying the Mustang's freedom, and sends the would-be killers to jail after the horse escapes and a landslide seals the mine away again.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Two ruthless gold seekers believe the legendary great white Mustang can lead them to the Lost Dutchman Mine and join a wild-horse hunt with Cisco, Pancho, and another prospector, but their greed turns murderous when they try to eliminate the others; Cisco survives their attacks, prevents them from destroying the Mustang's freedom, and sends the would-be killers to jail after the horse escapes and a landslide seals the mine away again.

episodes.title: When Killers Escape (1957-03-28)
episodes.episodeDescription: Two convicted killers overpower the sheriff transporting them from Holbrook, return to town for guns and supplies, and threaten the storekeeper who could help stop their escape; Cisco and Pancho pursue them, are gun-whipped and dropped into a hidden well to drown, but climb out, catch the fugitives before they can kill again, and make sure the pair are returned to prison.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Two convicted killers overpower the sheriff transporting them from Holbrook, return to town for guns and supplies, and threaten the storekeeper who could help stop their escape; Cisco and Pancho pursue them, are gun-whipped and dropped into a hidden well to drown, but climb out, catch the fugitives before they can kill again, and make sure the pair are returned to prison.

episodes.title: The Butterfield Overland Mail (1957-04-02)
episodes.episodeDescription: Bandits rob a Butterfield Overland Mail coach carrying a valuable jewel shipment and a young girl traveling with her supposed French nurse, but Cisco discovers the nurse is part of the plot when her false accent slips, exposes the gang, recovers the stolen jewelry, and sees the child safely reunited with her father.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Bandits rob a Butterfield Overland Mail coach carrying a valuable jewel shipment and a young girl traveling with her supposed French nurse, but Cisco discovers the nurse is part of the plot when her false accent slips, exposes the gang, recovers the stolen jewelry, and sees the child safely reunited with her father.

episodes.title: Westward to St Joe (1957-04-07)
episodes.episodeDescription: Bandits disguised as Pawnee Indians attack travelers heading west from St. Joseph, seize diamond dealer August Wagner's valuables, and capture Pancho to lure Cisco into an ambush, but Cisco recognizes the false trail, frees Pancho, breaks the masquerading gang, and recovers the diamonds.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Bandits disguised as Pawnee Indians attack travelers heading west from St. Joseph, seize diamond dealer August Wagner's valuables, and capture Pancho to lure Cisco into an ambush, but Cisco recognizes the false trail, frees Pancho, breaks the masquerading gang, and recovers the diamonds.

episodes.title: The Hook Murders (1957-04-09)
episodes.episodeDescription: A series of killings in the Buchanan family appears to be the work of a mysterious hook-handed murderer, but Cisco discovers that a family member and a crooked lawman are using a sharpened hook to eliminate relatives for the inheritance and plan to frame a traveling salesman who once sold similar hooked tools.
episodes.plotSynopsis: A series of killings in the Buchanan family appears to be the work of a mysterious hook-handed murderer, but Cisco discovers that a family member and a crooked lawman are using a sharpened hook to eliminate relatives for the inheritance and plan to frame a traveling salesman who once sold similar hooked tools.

episodes.title: The Angry Constable (1957-04-11)
episodes.episodeDescription: Crooks in outlaw-ridden Gailyville exploit recently released Alex Purdy's reputation to frame him for a stage robbery while hot-tempered constable Frank Grant is eager to make an arrest, but Cisco proves the same gang committed the earlier store robbery that sent Purdy to prison, stops their attack on the jail, and finally clears Purdy's name.
episodes.plotSynopsis: Crooks in outlaw-ridden Gailyville exploit recently released Alex Purdy's reputation to frame him for a stage robbery while hot-tempered constable Frank Grant is eager to make an arrest, but Cisco proves the same gang committed the earlier store robbery that sent Purdy to prison, stops their attack on the jail, and finally clears Purdy's name.

episodes.title: The Johnson County Raid (1957-04-16)
episodes.episodeDescription: John Meringue and a band of hired gunmen try to terrorize Bill Davidson and his father off their Johnson County ranch, even preparing to burn the buildings with the family trapped inside, but Cisco realizes Meringue has deceived him, joins the Davises' defense, and helps end the raid so cattlemen and homesteaders can return to peace.
